description: This file contains functions for parsing Lua documentation comments, extracting parameters, descriptions, examples, and generating module and method metadata for documentation purposes.

methods.name: from_md
methods.description: Converts Markdown-style inline code delimiters (`) into HTML <code> tags within the text.

methods.name: parse_param
methods.description: Parses a parameter string into a table with name and description.

methods.name: parse_description
methods.description: Extracts and concatenates the main description text from a comment block, excluding tags like @param and @example.

methods.name: parse_bottom_description
methods.description: Extracts the bottom part of the description from a comment block, handling @example sections.

methods.name: parse_return
methods.description: Parses the @return tag from a comment to extract return variable and description.

methods.name: parse_examples
methods.description: Extracts example code snippets from comment blocks, including handling @live and call indices.

methods.name: parse_calls
methods.description: Parses @call and @param tags from comments to build a list of call argument sets.

methods.name: parse_comment
methods.description: Parses a documentation comment block to extract method or event metadata, including name, description, examples, and calls.

methods.name: get_declaration
methods.description: Generates a function call string with method name and parameters.

methods.name: get_declarations
methods.description: Creates a list of function call strings for each method call.

methods.name: parse_params
methods.description: Extracts all @param tags from a comment block into a list of parameter tables.

methods.name: parse_header
methods.description: Parses source code to extract documented functions and callback methods, returning their metadata.

methods.name: remove_html_tags
methods.description: Removes HTML tags from a string.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Finds all header files in a directory, parses their documentation, and returns module metadata.
